call.command: for h in web1 db1; do echo "== $h"; ssh -n -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$h" 'df -P -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs; df -P -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs | awk -v L=80 "NR>1 && \$5+0>L {print \$6}" | while read m; do echo "-- $m"; du -xh --max-depth=2 "$m" 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -12; done; journalctl --disk-usage 2>&1; docker system df 2>&1; du -sh /var/cache/apt 2>&1' 2>&1; done

script.say:
**Full**
- web1 — / — 91% of 40G — /var/lib/docker 18G, /var/log 6.1G, /home 4G

**Could be cleared**
- web1 — unused Docker images — about 9.2G — `docker image prune -a`
- web1 — the journal beyond two weeks — part of its 4.0G — `journalctl --vacuum-time=2weeks`
- web1 — the package cache — 420M — `apt clean`

**Fine**
- db1 — / at 42%

- checked 2 machines in one command: 1 full disk; deleted nothing
